notes: No `envelope`: the area is most of what a SIGMET is for, so the client returns the whole feature, as `zones.get_zone` does.
The OpenAPI also offers `application/vnd.noaa.uswx+xml` here. This client asks for GeoJSON only.
A message that does not exist answers 500 `UnexpectedProblem`, not 404 (measured 2026-09-30, `/aviation/sigmets/KKCI/2026-09-30/0001`).

spec.description: One SIGMET or AIRMET, with its area, named by its unit and the UTC date and minute it was issued. Several messages a unit issues in the same minute share that name, and the service then answers one of them: measured 2026-09-30, `KKCI/2026-09-30/2355` answered the Kansas City region's SIGMET out of the several `KKCI` issued at 23:55. To see them all, filter `aviation.list_sigmets_for_atsu_on_date`.

request.title: GetSigmetRequest
request.description: Which message: its unit, issue date and issue time, as they end its URL.

atsu.description: Air traffic services unit, such as `KKCI` (the Aviation Weather Center, which issues the SIGMETs for the contiguous US) or `ANC` (Anchorage). Three or four capital letters.

date.description: UTC date the message was issued.

time.description: UTC time the message was issued, as `HHMM` (`2355`): the last segment of its URL. A clock time without a date, so not a timestamp format.
